title: What If You Went to Space Without a Suit?

lines.text: Rusty stepped out into space without a spacesuit.
Also no. Space is a vacuum, so his body loses heat very slowly.
First, he has to breathe out.
Holding his breath would rip his lungs apart.
Then the saliva on his tongue starts to boil.
The water in his body turns to vapor, and he swells up to twice his size.
Only his skin holds him together.
After about fifteen seconds, he passes out.
